clips.title: The story
paras: Dolanaar gathers travelers and guides beneath Teldrassil’s boughs. Southwest of Shadowglen, the town is the first place young night elves find after leaving their sheltered training grounds. Rangers, druids, and craftsmen help newcomers while strange afflictions spread through the World Tree.

Dolanaar is a crossroads for travelers crossing Teldrassil. Beneath the canopy southwest of Shadowglen, its homes and platforms follow the traditional night elven way, woven into the woodland. Young night elves come here for their first broad training in trades, martial arts, and nature crafts. The road west leads toward Darnassus, the capital. From the surrounding boughs come reports of corrupted wildlife, aggressive furbolgs, and foul mosses, all brought before Dolanaar’s council.
